query: The Archives Write Again The Royal Library Archives remember your summer. The keeper writes that a cataloguer's post is free from the autumn, "for someone who reads the footnotes", and that your name was the only one proposed. Answer by the last day. Write back in your best copperplate It takes an evening and four nibs. The keeper replies with a catalogue card made out in your name, under "Staff". Ask which room you'd be given "The cold one," the keeper writes, "with the folios that object to being opened." You will need gloves. You will also, you suspect, love it.

The Stacks Want You Back
A note under the bell on the reference desk, after your shift. The head librarian wants to keep you on after graduation, full time, as a keeper of the stacks. "Footnote has stopped biting you," it says. "That is a qualification." Answer by the last day.
